name: Befouled Bloodstone Orb
summary: The Befouled Bloodstone Orb is a magical relic held by a warlock in Stromgarde Keep. Tor'gan in Hammerfall seeks it to end its power over the land.

sections.title: A Tainted Relic
sections.body: Tor'gan fears a warlock in Stromgarde Keep is using a magical relic to summon demons. The Befouled Bloodstone Orb is the object he seeks, so its power can be destroyed before it taints Arathi Highlands further.

faq.q: What is the Befouled Bloodstone Orb?
faq.answer: The Befouled Bloodstone Orb is a magical relic held by Marez Cowl, a warlock in Stromgarde Keep.
Marez Cowl, a warlock within Stromgarde Keep, holds the Befouled Bloodstone Orb.
Tor'gan wants the orb so he can destroy it and keep its power from tainting Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What is the orb used for?
faq.answer: Tor'gan believes a warlock has used the orb to summon demons in large numbers.
Marez Cowl holds the orb inside the walls of Stromgarde Keep in Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: As a warlock, you know the danger of a relic used to summon demons. Tor'gan seeks to destroy the orb before its power can further taint Arathi Highlands.
